#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define mp make_pair
#define pb push_back
#define ll long long

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1E9+7;

int parent[1111111];
int component_count;

int find_parent(int x) {
    if (x == parent[x]) return x;
    return parent[x] = find_parent(parent[x]);
}

void unite(int a, int b) {
    a = find_parent(a);
    b = find_parent(b);
    if (a == b) return;
    component_count--;
    parent[b] = a;
}

ll mod_pow(ll base, int exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    ll half = mod_pow(base, exp / 2);
    ll result = (half * half) % MOD;
    if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    if (k == 0) {
        cout << mod_pow(p, p - 1) << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    component_count = p - (k > 1);
    for (ll i = 1; i < p; i++) parent[i] = i;

    for (ll i = 1; i < p; i++) {
        unite(i, (i * k) % p);
    }

    cout << mod_pow(p, component_count) << '\n';

    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
